api: 分红再投入收益率排名API

description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆公募基金的分红再投入收益率（比涨跌幅更契合实际盈利情况）排名数据。可按基金代码批量查询返回最新数据日期、各时间段收益率排名（成立以来/近1月/3月/6月/1年/2年/3年/5年/10年）以及各时间段在同类基金中的排名分位。当用户想了解某公募基金或者对比某些公募基金在不同周期下的收益率排名的统计数据，判断基金在同类中的相对表现时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain dividend reinvestment return ranking data for A-share funds. Supports batch query by fund code, returning fields such as latest data date and return rankings for different periods (since inception/1 month/3 months/6 months/1 year/2 years/3 years/5 years/10 years) as well as ranking percentiles among similar funds for each period. Call this interface when users want to understand the return ranking of a fund for each period or assess its relative performance among similar funds.
